newsitem.title: GREECE: BASKETBALL-PANATHINAIKOS KNOCK PAU OUT OF EUROLEAGUE.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-PANATHINAIKOS KNOCK PAU OUT OF EUROLEAGUE.

text.p: Holders Panathinaikos recovered in the second half to beat Pau Orthez of France 75-71 on Wednesday and knock them out of contention for the EuroLeague title.

Injury-stricken Orthez put on a heroic effort with only six players in their squad, outplaying their opponents in the first half to be 41-31 ahead at the interval and holding the lead into the final minute of the game.
But with 30 seconds left in this group G qualifier and Pau ahead 71-70, Panathinaikos' American playmaker Byron Dinkins (15 points) hit a three-pointer to put the Greeks in control.
Orthez missed the fast break and fouled, giving Panathinaikos forward Julius Nuosou two successful free throws for the final 75-71 scoreline.
The French, who left their two top stars Antoine Rigadeau and Lorens Fandeberg back home, had youngster Fabien Dubos as the top-scorer with 20 points and Thierry Gadou with 19.
Panathinaikos finished the second round top in their group and will have a home advantage in the playoffs.
